purpose: Key-addressed source-preserving package publication and offline/online rights-aware hydration over existing FileSpace/DataSpace/CCC and LS runtime, with no blockchain dependency.

key_types.fileset_key: Public/nonsecret locator for a versioned manifest, never proof of access.
key_types.content_key: Full SHA-256 and byte count for exact source blob; object identity distinct.
key_types.object_id: Authoritative domain-owned referent, not derived from content key.
key_types.profile_ref: Opaque user/project binding in permissioned directory; never embed personal identity in shareable public manifest.
key_types.grant_ref: Server-verified signed/short-lived entitlement, revocable and separate from fileset key; never embedded in public kit.
key_types.namespace_key: Signed owner-resolved domain/subfamily namespace, never a first-come name claim without policy.

exchange_rules: Receiver must prove same base root before applying sparse delta.
Missing content must be fetched from authorised provider or explicitly marked NOT_CACHED.
Encrypted private packet requires authenticated key exchange and client verification; key locator alone is never decryption or authorisation.
Profile linking must not disclose other subscribers of the same object.
Revoke grants for future access but never claim to remotely erase already exported unencrypted public bytes.
Source transforms R1 reversible only where exact inverse is tested; R2/R3 synthetic or interpretive output remains derivative.
Use standard digests and digital signatures, do not invent geometry-based cryptography.
Publication root is versioned, signed, and must undergo source/rights/private-asset review before public exposure.
Offline entitlement/accessibility must be decided at packaging time; offline cannot contact an auth server.
Signed proof and permission scopes gate privileged writes; server has final authority.

public_bandwidth_reserve.name_qualification: If prior notes mean Schumann resonances, they are not an assignable networking band.
public_bandwidth_reserve.intent: Reserve measurable quotas for public-basic and emergency/offline access on actual provisioned transports.
rules: Publish measured effective usable bytes and admission queues per transport.
Emergency life-safety priority is scoped, publicly documented and revocable with human oversight.
No hidden political-viewpoint weighting or public knowledge suppression.
Paid tier cannot silently starve the guaranteed public baseline.
Wireless spectrum allocation or cable capacity requires separate operator/regulatory permission.
Country-aware jurisdiction metadata and locale/language adaptation are not a replacement for legitimate legal review.
Avoid automatic surveillance, content censorship or irreversible suppression based solely on geolocation or government purchaser.
Keep public source references and transparent notices of legally restricted availability where lawful.
Users need notice, correction/appeal pathway, independent oversight and accessible portability.
Private or health-related records do not enter public packages without specific informed consent.
Institutional and public governance licences must not transfer EMASSC/Romer/Eco-Grex IP by inference.
Regional data storage requires actual contracted host regions and compliance readback; a geo label is not physical data sovereignty.

resolution: Preserve original hash/source/revision, distinguish same-byte vs same-referent.
Use typed relation and review; do not silently overwrite contested claims.
Store payoff log with evidence delta, alternative and owner decision.
Record R0/R1/R2/R3/F independently; AI inference is source-marked R3 until independent validation.
Keep older source accessible and allow revised understanding to supersede via dated claim links, not rewrite history.

deployment_kits.humanitarian_note: Five proposed module roles are a conceptual allocation, not verified container counts, site/engineering design, emergency certification or deliverable kit.

boundary: Review-only schema; no deployments, keys, credentials, public end-user URLs, host operations, publication transactions, physical networks, biometric/health ingestion or canonical source mutation.
